name: Pointe-Noire
scopeLimits: The WUP locator is a settlement centroid, not a parcel identity. Published plans are case-specific and do not establish coverage at the ranked point. No plan polygon or owner/address data was retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
